proof:
by
  intro v0 v1 v2 v3 h
  simp only [pre, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hf, ⟨hr, hu⟩, hl⟩
  let a := (v0 - v1) * 10000
  let d := 10000 + v2
  let q := a / d
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; omega
  have hn : d ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by omega
  have hlo : d * q ≤ a := Int.mul_ediv_self_le hn
  have hhi : a < d * q + d := Int.lt_mul_ediv_self_add hd
  change post (max 0 (min v3 q)) v0 v1 v2 v3 = true
  by_cases hq : q ≤ 0
  · have hm : d * q ≤ 0 := by
      have ht := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hd0
      simpa using ht
    have ha : a < d := by omega
    have hx : v2 > (v0 - 1 - v1) * 10000 := by
      dsimp only [a, d] at ha
      simp only [Int.sub_mul]
      omega
    have hz : max 0 (min v3 q) = 0 := by
      simp only [Int.min_def, Int.max_def]
      split <;> first | omega | (split <;> omega)
    rw [hz]
    simp [post, hb, hl, hx]
  · have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by omega
    have hp : 0 ≤ v2 * q := Int.mul_nonneg hr hq0
    have hqb : q ≤ v0 := by
      dsimp only [a, d] at hlo
      simp only [Int.add_mul, Int.sub_mul] at hlo
      omega
    have hqbgt : q * v2 ≤ (v0 - q - v1) * 10000 := by
      dsimp only [a, d] at hlo
      simp only [Int.add_mul, Int.sub_mul] at hlo
      rw [Int.mul_comm q v2]
      simp only [Int.sub_mul]
      omega
    have hqn : (q + 1) * v2 > (v0 - (q + 1) - v1) * 10000 := by
      dsimp only [a, d] at hhi
      simp only [Int.add_mul, Int.sub_mul] at hhi ⊢
      rw [Int.mul_comm q v2]
      omega
    by_cases hc : v3 ≤ q
    · have hcl : d * v3 ≤ a := Int.le_trans (Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hd0) hlo
      have hcb : v3 ≤ v0 := by omega
      have hcbgt : v3 * v2 ≤ (v0 - v3 - v1) * 10000 := by
        dsimp only [a, d] at hcl
        simp only [Int.add_mul, Int.sub_mul] at hcl
        rw [Int.mul_comm v3 v2]
        simp only [Int.sub_mul]
        omega
      have hz : max 0 (min v3 q) = v3 := by
        simp [Int.min_def, Int.max_def, hc, hl]
      rw [hz]
      simp [post, hl, hcb, hcbgt]
    · have hqc : q ≤ v3 := by omega
      have hz : max 0 (min v3 q) = q := by
        simp [Int.min_def, Int.max_def, hc, hq0]
      rw [hz]
      simp [post, hq0, hqc, hqb, hqbgt, hqn]
